{{Top|italics=1}}
{{Quote|Sai cha comes from the ancient words for 'separate' and 'head', and as you might expect it describes the act of using a lightsaber to behead an opponent.|[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Jangodied.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] using ''sai cha'' on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], beheading [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].]]

In [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], a '''''sai cha''''' was an instance when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] beheaded their opponent. In general, ''sai cha'' was reserved for either [[Droid/Legends|droids]] or biological opponents that presented a great danger and resisted non-lethal subduing attacks (such as [[Cho mai/Legends|cho mai]]). Only individuals like [[Simus]] with great strength in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] were able to survive it, and even in his case it may have been impossible without the particular physiology of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]].

It was one of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] techniques known as [[The Marks of Contact]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> It considered the second-most appropriate way of killing, if a Jedi was obliged to end a life with a lightsaber.<ref>[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)'']]</ref>

==Notable uses==
{{Quote|Do you think you'll still be able to call on the Force after I've separated your head from your body?|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]|<ref name="Cloak of Darkness">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sai_cha_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Rachi Sitra|Jedi]] beheading a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]].]]
*Droids were regarded by most [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] as neither honorable nor dishonorable, with the exception of a few heroic notables. For example, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] beheaded [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]] on board the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] and during the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="SWROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
*During the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and after [[Time travel/Legends|time traveling]] into [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], [[Relin Druur]] beheaded a few [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors aboard the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>
*[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] used ''sai cha'' during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] to end the life of [[Warb Null]].<ref name="FNU">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]]</ref>
*During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], [[Darth Angral]] used ''sai cha'' on the helpless [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Berooken]] in his office.<ref name="SWTOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] applied ''sai cha'' against a defenseless [[Sirak]] when the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] begged for mercy.
*[[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] decapitated Jedi Master [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] in a lightsaber battle in the [[Belia Darzu's fortress|Fortress]] of [[Belia Darzu]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].
*[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] decapitated [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bartender [[Quano]] after he discovered she and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] were from [[Ciutric IV]] to protect the future of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
*In [[37 BBY/Legends|37 BBY]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was forced to apply the ''sai cha'' against [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] [[Omnino]] of [[Vena]], as she was in possession of a psychic augmenter, a sophisticated device that enabled her to control the minds of others. Jinn was forced to decapitate her to save the lives of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], and knocking the Baroness unconscious was not an option, as her dangerous mind may have remained active.
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] used ''sai cha'' to kill [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in the [[Petranaki arena]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="SWAOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> He also attempted to use this move on [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], until [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] intervened, leading to Windu's death at the hands of Sidious.<ref name="SWROTS" />
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used ''Sai cha'' on a [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] during [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|Mission to Skytop Station]].
*Ventress attempted ''sai cha'' on [[King/Legends|King]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], until [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] intervened.
*[[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used ''sai cha'' on a [[Unidentified Green Company trooper/Legends|Green Company trooper]] during the [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|Rescue on the Tranquility]].
[[File:ThereCanBeOnlyOne-SoR.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] uses ''Sai cha'' on a defenseless [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].]]
*The [[Secret Mandalore]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] attempted ''sai cha'' on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], until [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] intervened. Tano then used ''sai cha'' to behead four of Vizsla's [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] warriors.
*The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] used [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|Saber throw]] and ''sai cha'' to behead four [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] warriors, including [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]], during their [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|Mission to Mustafar]].
*[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] performed several brutal ''sai cha'' marks: first on several villagers on [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]]<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}''</ref> and later on the Death Watch's [[Secret Mandalore]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] in the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Mandalore Throne Room]] during their [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover of Sundari]].<ref name="SOR">''{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>
*Anakin Skywalker applied ''sai cha'' on [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] onboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="TCSWE" /><ref name="SWROTS" /> Notably, this instance was carried out using two lightsabers in a scissor movement, and was performed on an already helpless opponent.
[[File:DookuBeheading-ROTS.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] uses ''sai cha'' on a defenseless [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]].]]
*On [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] performed ''sai cha'' on [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] and a fellow trooper after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was initiated.<ref name="SWROTS" />
*During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Darth Vader was infamous for beheading his opponents with his lightsaber.<ref name="SWROTS" /> [[Bol Chatak]], [[Iwo Kulka]] and [[Siadem Forte]] were among his more well-known victims.<ref name="DWTRODV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>
*Several Jedi were also forced to employ ''sai cha'' during the Great Jedi Purge. These include [[Roan Shryne]], who performed ''sai cha'' upon Commander [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Imperial invasion of Kashyyyk]],<ref name="DWTRODV" /> and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], who applied it against a clone commander in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
*[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] decapitated [[Resk]] during his time as a bounty hunter.
*[[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] performed two brutal ''sai cha'' marks: first on a helpless [[Morgan Katarn]], and later on Jedi Master [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]].<ref name="DFSFE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref><ref name="DFRE">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref><ref name="JKDF">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref>
*In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used a swift ''sai cha'' on [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Ocheron]] to save [[Singing Mountain Clan]] member [[Teneniel Djo]].<ref name="TCOPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
*In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], two-year-old [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], with the spiritual assistance of his uncle Luke, was able to apply ''sai cha'' to one of the heads of a [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydra]].<ref name="CotF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>
*In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], Tahiri Veila applied ''sai cha'' on [[Master Shaper]] [[Mezhan Kwaad]] using [[Anakin Solo's lightsaber]].<ref name="eov1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>
*Jedi Master Luke Skywalker applied ''sai cha'' during his final confrontation with [[Shimrra Jamaane]], [[Supreme Overlord]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Skywalker beheaded Jamaane with the crossed blades of both his and his nephew [[Anakin Solo|Anakin's]] lightsaber,<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> much like how his father Anakin beheaded Count Dooku nearly fifty years before.<ref name="SWAOTC" />
*Jedi Master [[Tresina Lobi]] felled by a ''sai cha'' strike from [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]], during [[Duel in the Fellowship Plaza|their duel]] in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Fellowship Plaza]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
*Dark Lady [[Lumiya]] received a ''sai cha'' strike from Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, ending both their [[Duel on Terephon|duel]] and her life.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>
*In the underlevels of Coruscant, Darth Caedus applied ''sai cha'' against the Falleen Jedi [[Thann Mithric]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>
*Luke Skywalker used ''sai cha'' to finish off Sith Lady [[Olaris Rhea]] during the [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station]].<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
*During a [[duel in the Dathomir landing meadow]], Jedi Knight [[Ben Skywalker]], applied ''sai cha'' to a Sith Saber.
*On the planet [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]], a [[Unidentified Rodian Sith|Rodian Sith]] received a ''sai cha'' strike from [[Shado Vao]] at the end of the skirmish.
*[[Darth Stryfe]] beheaded [[Darth Reave]] after he transformed into a [[rakghoul]] mutant on [[Had Abbadon]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 30: Vector, Part 11">[[Legacy (2006) 30|''Legacy'' (2006) 30]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Beheading of opponents is normally not available in ''Star Wars'' computer games, because of censorship and rating issues. However, in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', beheading and general [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismemberment]] are possible using the "Saber Realistic Combat" function which is accessible through a [[Wikipedia:Cheat Code|cheat code]]. In some cases, enemies don't even need to be attacked if they are running right toward the player, simply by turning in their direction. It is also available in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]].

In the novelization of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] kills both [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] this way, and proceeds to decorate his desk with the deceased Master Fisto's head.<ref name="SWROTSN">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

In the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' episodes "Eminence" and "Shades of Reason," the Cartoon Network airings of the episodes had censored the scenes where Savage Opress and Darth Maul performed sai cha on the Black Sun leadership council and Pre Vizsla, respectively. The cut sequences were restored on the DVD/Blu Ray release.
